title: Police Blotter: 15 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Fifteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, family-violence assault, marijuana possession, criminal trespass, criminal mischief, theft, and federal and out-of-county holds among them. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Fifteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday, October 23, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

TOVAR, KRYSTAL KIMBERLY

TOVAR, KRYSTAL KIMBERLY was arrested on Friday, October 23, 2026, at 5:09 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

SALINAS, RAMBERTO was arrested on Friday, October 23, 2026, at 6:49 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol content of 0.15 or higher. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

CRUZ-VAZQUEZ, JESUS HUMBERTO was arrested on Friday, October 23, 2026, at 9:59 a.m. and is being held by the United States Marshals on an alleged federal violation hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.
